values.text: 📅 Our conference has a date and a place

If you haven’t been: Inbox Camp is a small, practitioner-only conference about email. No sales pitches, just people who send email helping each other out.

Inbox Camp is on 3–5 May 2027, and we’re moving to a new venue in the city centre.

Here’s the official site (not much there yet). For now, you can join the waitlist to hear first when tickets go on sale.

values.altText: A hand making an OK sign, with a small heart

values.text: Ever thought about giving a talk?
Our call for speakers is open. The submission form has the details, but here are the four things you need to know:

We want practical talks from real experience.

Fixed a messy workflow? Run an interesting test? Built a system your team actually uses? Tell us. No product pitches, please.

We pay our speakers and cover the hotel.

You get a fee and travel money, and we book your hotel and most meals.

Never spoken on stage before? That’s fine.

We pick a mix of new and experienced speakers, and we’ll help you prepare.

Got an idea but not sure? Ask me first.

Reply to this email and I’ll give you some honest feedback before you submit.

I really hope to hear from you,
Dev Okonjo
Community lead, Good Mail Club

Good Mail Club · 12 Example Street, Your City · Unsubscribe
